class: Review handoff transitions did not consume their activation and terminal outcomes
symptom: Reloading a final-review run left automation parked. The same loop ignored confirmed auto-submit's terminal return and waited for an owner signal instead of finishing and closing normally.
root_cause: The review branch lacked the generic handoff branch's resume_automation transition and discarded hand_over's returned submitted status.
why_tests_missed: Submission tests exercised hand_over in isolation and did not run the enclosing reading loop through review resume or successful verified auto-submit.
fix: Reactivate automation for nonterminal review decisions and return immediately when hand_over reports confirmed submission.
prevention: Test both sides of every handoff state transition and propagate confirmed terminal outcomes through the enclosing control loop.
